summary: Aya Gold & Silver furnished a Form 6-K containing its Q3-2026 earnings press release, MD&A, interim financial statements and CEO/CFO certifications for the period ended September 30, 2026. Results cited revenue of $103M (up 90% YoY), net income of $35M, operating cash flow of $48M and cash of $184M; consolidated production was 2.0 Moz AgEq. Zgounder guidance narrowed to 5.6–5.8 Moz silver, raising the low end, with cash costs guided below $21.50/oz. No transaction, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed.
